description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to detecting overload conditions in transaction processing within the Orleans framework. It includes options for load shedding based on transaction rate, and implements logic to monitor transaction throughput and determine overload status.

classes.name: ITransactionOverloadDetector
classes.description: Interface defining a method to check if the transaction system is overloaded.

classes.name: TransactionRateLoadSheddingOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for load shedding based on transaction rate, including whether it is enabled and the limit threshold.

classes.name: TransactionOverloadDetector
classes.description: Implements overload detection logic by monitoring transaction throughput and comparing it against configured limits.

methods.name: RecordStatistics
methods.description: Records current transaction statistics and updates the transaction rate calculation.

methods.name: IsOverloaded
methods.description: Determines whether the system is currently overloaded based on transaction rate and configured limits.

methods.name: CalculateTps
methods.description: Calculates transactions per second over a time interval.
